stem_book: The system of two weights with masses m₁ = 3 kg (on top) and m₂ = 5 kg (below) are connected with a weightless spring as shown. The system is resting on the support S. The support S is quickly removed. Find the acceleration (in m/s²) of the 5 kg block right after the support S is removed. (g = 10 m/s²)
reason: Print drops the '5' in 'of 5 kg' at the page edge; restored (key 16 confirms).
work: spring force = 3g = 30 N unchanged instantly ; a₅ = (50 + 30)/5 = 16 m/s²
